from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')

p=pdir/'task-90e0e67f.py'
source='''from collections import Counter
\ndef transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next(value for value, count in counts.items() if value != background)
    return [[foreground if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task90',p)
